options.name: api_password
options.description: Password of the user to login into OpenNebula OneFlow API server. If not set then the value of the E(ONEFLOW_PASSWORD) environment variable is used.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the OpenNebula OneFlow API server. It is recommended to use HTTPS so that the username/password are not transferred over the network unencrypted. If not set then the value of the E(ONEFLOW_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: api_username
options.description: Name of the user to login into the OpenNebula OneFlow API server. If not set then the value of the E(ONEFLOW_USERNAME) environment variable is used.

options.name: cardinality
options.description: Number of VMs for the specified role.

options.name: custom_attrs
options.description: Dictionary of key/value custom attributes which is used when instantiating a new service.

options.name: force
options.description: Force the new cardinality even if it is outside the limits.

options.name: group_id
options.description: ID of the group which is set as the group of the service.

options.name: mode
options.description: Set permission mode of a service instance in octet format, for example V(0600) to give owner C(use) and C(manage) and nothing to group and others.

options.name: owner_id
options.description: ID of the user which is set as the owner of the service.

options.name: role
options.description: Name of the role whose cardinality should be changed.

options.name: service_id
options.description: ID of a service instance that you would like to manage.

options.name: service_name
options.description: Name of a service instance that you would like to manage.

options.name: state
options.description: V(present) - instantiate a service from a template specified with O(template_id) or O(template_name). V(absent) - terminate an instance of a service specified with O(template_id) or O(template_name).

options.name: template_id
options.description: ID of a service template to use to create a new instance of a service.

options.name: template_name
options.description: Name of service template to use to create a new instance of a service.

options.name: unique
options.description: Setting O(unique=true) ensures that there is only one service instance running with a name set with O(service_name) when instantiating a service from a template specified with O(template_id) or O(template_name). Check examples below.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the instance to reach RUNNING state after DEPLOYING or COOLDOWN state after SCALING.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
